title: Lesson (stub)
description: STUB schema for the teaching layer (core design doc §6.2). Lessons are deferred past v1 but the schema is not: a lesson is data — a sequence of component-library scenes with synced narration, audio via the §2.9 TTS layer. One atomic skill = one micro-lesson of 3–7 minutes (§6.1).

skill_id.description: The atomic skill this lesson teaches (§6.2). Migrations queue the parent node's lesson for re-review on node splits (§3 Stage 6).

pedagogy_variant.description: Which curriculum's method the worked example teaches, selected via the mapping layer (§6.2; §1.4), e.g. NCERT.

type.description: The four segments of §6.1: hook → concept → worked example → guided practice (I do → we do → you do).

component.description: A component from the §2.9 library, e.g. fraction_bar.

scenes.description: §2.9 component choreography for authored segments (hook, concept).

narration_i18n.description: Synced narration text keyed by language (§6.2); audio comes from the §2.9 TTS layer.

watch_out.description: Preemptive misconception call-outs in the concept segment, from the skill's top misconceptions in the registry (§6.1 segment 2).

template_ref.description: Worked-example segment: the template instance played forward (§6.1 segment 3).

template_refs.description: Guided-practice segment: the verified templates used at easy depth (§6.1 segment 4).

tier.description: Difficulty tier of the referenced templates (§6.2).

fading.description: Faded worked-example sequence, derived from stored solution_steps (§6.1 segment 3).

hints.description: Guided-practice hint policy; lesson hints are pre-opened by design (§6.2; student-model doc §3).

review_status.description: Human review is 100%, permanently, for lessons (§6.3 Stage 4).

provenance.description: Same provenance discipline as items (§6.2; §3 Stage 5).
